note: Items the contract needs but the extractor cannot see from the page struct: §1-required rows the baseline only declares in dead code (`specRequired`), and actions rendered by a sibling view struct (`baselineReachable: true`). Each keeps its `File.swift:line` provenance; the `spec-baseline-mismatch` check treats a `specRef` on an entry as the acknowledgement for that §1 entrance.

entries.label: 运行时详情
entries.reason: README §1 lists RuntimeDetailsPage's entrance as `页头运行状态点、设置行`. The baseline declares this settings row only inside the never-referenced `advancedSection` (label 运行状态), so its body never renders it. §1 wins: the Android row is named after the page (运行时详情), not after the dead label.

entries.label: 提交回答
entries.reason: `QuestionCard` is a sibling view struct (ChatPage.swift:2139), outside the page struct the extractor walks; the card is rendered in ChatPage's pending-answer slot and Android implements the submit button.

entries.label: 打开会话列表
entries.reason: The drawer button has no visible text: its accessible name is the only label. Without it in the contract, merging the drawer and ⋯ header buttons into one `HeaderAction(label, glyph, …)` would be reported as `extra-action '打开会话列表'`, which is why the page carries two near-duplicate header components.
